svg.font-family: Hanken Grotesk, Segoe UI, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: A table of eight rows naming what RAW v1.0 declares, how many of each are in the tree, and where each number comes from. The DirectX 12 bridge shader directory holds 60 HLSL shaders and 34 shared HLSLI includes. The d3d11.dll proxy wraps three Direct3D objects: the device, the context and the swap chain. The C++23 source tree holds 352 implementation files and 328 headers. The BuildLang Mod SDK exposes ABI v2.0 through raw_mod_sdk.bld. Every target compiles to C++23 and the repository license is MIT.
